instruction.text: Spell the word to find out what it means.
instruction.sound: ssml: Spell the word to find out what it means. <break time='500ms'/> Needs.

feedback.end: Needs are things we must have in order to survive. They help us stay healthy.

instruction.text: Food is a very important need. Find the food on the image.

feedback.end: Food gives us our energy to live.

instruction.text: Water is a basic need. Find the water.

feedback.end: Water is important for drinking and washing. This keeps your body healthy.

instruction.text: We also need air to live. Find the open window letting in fresh air.
Shelter is another basic need. It protects us from dangerous weather. Find where you could find shelter in the image.

feedback.end: Our houses are where we take shelter from the heat and the cold.

instruction.text: Clothes are also things we need. Find the clothes in the image.

feedback.end: Clothes protect us from the cold and heat. They help us to feel comfortable.

instruction.text: Sleep is another one of our needs. Find the girl in the bed to hear about the positive sides of sleep.

feedback.end: Your body needs enough sleep to work properly. Sleep gives you enough energy for all sorts of activities, like playtime or focusing in school.

instruction.text: Match the description to the picture of the need.

b.sound: Water helps us with thirst and feeling clean.

instruction.text: Match the description to the picture of the need.

b.sound: Shelter is a place where you can stay warm and dry.
Clothes help keep you warm and comfortable.
Sleep is the most important form of rest.
